name: react-starter
description: Minimal React integration for a Webrium project: a second Vite entry, a placeholder component, a controller and layout to mount it, wired together as a working example. Not an admin panel or any other real feature — just proof that React is set up correctly, ready for you to build on.
author: Webrium
post_install_message:
<options=bold>Finish setting up react-starter:</>

  1. npm install react react-dom @vitejs/plugin-react
  2. Wire react() + the 'react-demo' entry into vite.config.js
  3. Add the /react-demo route

Full details (exact before/after diffs) are in <options=bold>REACT-STARTER-SETUP.md</> at your project root — also written so an AI coding assistant can carry them out directly. Delete it once done.
